Cicada songs and lemon drops — a shiny coin for choco-pops.
lines.zh: 蝉鸣与柠檬糖——一枚亮闪闪的硬币换巧克力泡芙。

lines.en: A puddle near that old oak tree — the things that you would do to me.
lines.zh: 老橡树旁的一洼积水——你曾对我做过的那些事。

lines.en: Play make-believe. Play hide and seek. Play hopscotch during Golden Week.
lines.zh: 玩过家家。玩捉迷藏。黄金周里玩跳房子。

lines.en: That hamster wheel we bought last year — a picture book of grazing deer.
lines.zh: 去年买的那只仓鼠跑轮——一本画着吃草小鹿的绘本。

lines.en: And a pile of rocks that does naught but make me wish that I was home.
lines.zh: 还有一堆石头，别无他用，只让我希望自己还在家里。

lines.en: With tickle-fights and bug-filled nets — we’d stare up at that spring sunset.
lines.zh: 挠痒大战与装满虫子的捕虫网——我们曾一起仰望那个春日的夕阳。

lines.en: Think “This is great!” or “Wonderful!” or “Splendid view!” or “Colorful!”
lines.zh: 想着“真好啊！”或“太棒了！”或“景色绝佳！”或“五彩斑斓！”

lines.en: Or “I think I’m sad” or “My head still hurts” or “I’m really sad” or “My stomach hurts.”
lines.zh: 或者“我好像很难过”或“头还在疼”或“我真的很伤心”或“肚子好痛”。

lines.en: We used to think so many things. We had so many songs to sing.
lines.zh: 我们曾经想那么多事。我们有那么多歌要唱。

lines.en: But now we rarely open our mouths because our teeth keep dripping onto our candy bars.
lines.zh: 可如今我们很少张嘴，因为牙齿总是不停地往下滴，落在我们的糖果棒上。

lines.en: Such better days, I miss our youth! I miss all of my time with you!
lines.zh: 那些日子多好啊，我想念我们的青春！我想念与你共度的所有时光！

lines.en: I miss falling down. Miss bandaged knees. Miss fireflies and centipedes.
lines.zh: 我想念摔倒。想念缠着绷带的膝盖。想念萤火虫和蜈蚣。

lines.en: Miss the way you looked when you’d look at me. Miss the way I looked when I couldn’t see.
lines.zh: 想念你看我时的样子。想念我看不见时自己的模样。

lines.en: I can do that now. All the light’s grown in. But my youth is gone, I’m spread too thin.
lines.zh: 现在我能看见了。光全都长进来了。可青春已逝，我被摊得太薄。

lines.en: And I keep seeing things that I know aren’t actually there but they {i}feel{/i} like they’re there and I’ve begun to pull my hair out.
lines.zh: 而我总看见那些我明知道并不存在的东西，可它们给人的{i}感觉{/i}就在那儿，我已经开始一根根薅自己的头发了。

lines.en: Cherry-scented soap and pine — a silly tune to pass the time.
lines.zh: 樱桃味的香皂和松树——一段傻乎乎的曲子用来打发时间。

lines.en: A paddleboat through River Styx — a skeleton! A house with bricks!
lines.zh: 划着脚踏船穿过冥河——一具骷髅！一栋砖砌的房子！

lines.en: A knife wound in your upper thigh — I’ll press down hard so you won’t cry.
lines.zh: 你大腿上那道刀伤——我会用力按住，这样你就不会哭了。

lines.en: It’s soup again. It’s dinner time. I’ll hold your hand if you hold mine.
lines.zh: 又是汤。晚饭时间到了。你握我的手，我就握你的手。

lines.en: I don’t know how much longer I can keep having these dreams of our youth without sweetening my midnight tea with arsenic.
lines.zh: 我不知道自己还能再做多久这些关于我们青春的梦，而不往午夜的茶里加点砒霜。

lines.en: Some nights I think it would make them last forever.
lines.zh: 有些夜里，我觉得那样能让它们永远持续下去。

lines.en: Some nights I think I’m being watched.
lines.zh: 有些夜里，我觉得有人在看着我。

lines.en: - Girl
lines.zh: - 女孩

lines.en: {i}Something approaches.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}有什么东西正在靠近。{/i}

lines.en: scene mayashrinemad2
: I am Wilford Blackhole Hands.
lines.zh: : 我是 Wilford Blackhole Hands。

lines.en: : Okay.
Wilford slaps me across the face.
lines.zh: Wilford 一巴掌扇在我脸上。

lines.en: : Ouch. Why would you do that?
lines.zh: : 好痛。你为什么要这么做？

lines.en: He does it again.
lines.zh: 他又来了一下。

lines.en: : Hey. Stop that.
lines.zh: : 嘿。别这样。

lines.en: : If you take three steps back, you’ll be out of my reach and I will not be able to hit you anymore.
lines.zh: : 你要是往后退三步，就出了我的范围，我就再也打不到你了。

lines.en: I do as he says and take three steps back.
lines.zh: 我照他说的，往后退了三步。

lines.en: He attempts to slap me again, but misses.
lines.zh: 他试图再扇我一次，却落空了。

lines.en: It appears he wasn’t lying to me. I think that I can trust him.
lines.zh: 看来他没有骗我。我觉得我可以信任他。

lines.en: : What are you doing at the shrine, Wilford Blackhole Hands?
lines.zh: : 你在神社做什么，Wilford Blackhole Hands？

lines.en: : Looking for you. Your students were almost eaten by alligators today while you were taking a piss in a somewhat secluded outhouse.
lines.zh: : 找你。今天你的学生们差点被短吻鳄吃掉，而你正躲在一间比较偏僻的茅房里撒尿。

lines.en: : I’m trying to earn a new nickname and have to be careful not to let any more accidents happen.
lines.zh: : 我正想挣个新外号，所以得小心点，不能再出什么意外了。

lines.en: : Accidents will always happen so long as you’re around. You should leave this place forever.
lines.zh: : 只要你在，意外就永远会发生。你应该永远离开这个地方。

lines.en: : Well, that’s certainly rude, Wilford Blackhole Hands. Why would you come all the way over here just to tell me that?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，这话可真失礼，Wilford Blackhole Hands。你大老远跑过来，就为了跟我说这个？

lines.en: : I also came here to pray.
lines.zh: : 我也是来祈祷的。

lines.en: : To which god do you direct your prayers?
lines.zh: : 那你向哪一位神明祈祷？

lines.en: : Necalli, God of Knives. I’m just three badges away from earning my golden scepter.
lines.zh: : Necalli，刀之神。我只差三枚徽章就能拿到我的黄金权杖了。

lines.en: : Well, I wish you the best of luck. We all know how tough it can be moving through the system of more modern religions.
lines.zh: : 那祝你好运。我们都知道，在更现代的宗教体系里往上爬有多难。

lines.en: : When I earn my scepter, my reach will be extended and I will be able to slap you from further away.
lines.zh: : 等我拿到权杖，我的手臂范围就会延长，从更远的地方也扇得到你。

lines.en: : Why are you so intent on hitting me? I’ve done nothing to harm you.
lines.zh: : 你为什么这么执著于打我？我可什么都没做过伤害你的事。

lines.en: Wilford swings his scepterless arms again, but I am safe.
lines.zh: Wilford 又挥动起他那没有权杖的手臂，但我是安全的。

lines.en: : I do not bite my thumb at you, but at the fallout of your actions and how they have impacted my vacation schedule.
lines.zh: : 我朝你咬大拇指，针对的不是你本人，而是你那些行为引发的余波，以及它们对我度假日程造成的影响。

lines.en: : I never meant to impact anybody’s vacation schedule. I’m just having a tough go of it right now.
lines.zh: : 我从没想过要影响谁的度假计划。我只是最近日子不太好过。

lines.en: : This never would have happened if you had only been stronger.
lines.zh: : 要是你再坚强一点，这一切就不会发生。

lines.en: : I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : This never would have happened if you did not pretend to be a good man.
lines.zh: : 要是你没有装成一个好人，这一切就不会发生。

lines.en: : I never did.
lines.zh: : 我从来没有装过。

lines.en: : But you thought it. And sometimes, our thoughts are all that matter.
lines.zh: : 但你想过。而有时候，我们的念头才是唯一重要的东西。

lines.en: : Like when you want to buy someone a present but you can’t so you just tell them about the present you wanted to buy them and hope they say it’s okay?
lines.zh: : 就像你想给某人买礼物却买不起，于是就告诉对方你本来想买什么，然后希望对方说没关系那样？

lines.en: : That isn’t very far off. But still, I do not like you.
lines.zh: : 差不多是这个意思。不过，我还是不喜欢你。

lines.en: The half-translucent miscarriage inside of Wilford Blackhole Hands’ black hole stomach begin to pulsate and change inside. It looks like it wants to speak as well.
lines.zh: Wilford Blackhole Hands 那黑洞肚子里半透明的流产胎儿开始在里面搏动、变形。看样子它也想说话。

lines.en: : I think your baby wants a word.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你的宝宝想说两句。

lines.en: : It just had ten of them for breakfast. It’s time for baby’s burp. But my arms don’t bend the way they should, which is why I have developed this convenient black hole in my stomach.
lines.zh: : 它早餐刚吞了十个词。现在该给宝宝拍嗝了。可我的手臂弯不成该有的样子，所以我才在肚子里开发了这么个方便的黑洞。

lines.en: : Will the baby stay there forever?
lines.zh: : 宝宝会永远待在那儿吗？

lines.en: : It will pop out when it’s ripe.
lines.zh: : 熟了自然会掉出来。

lines.en: : Have you chosen a name yet?
lines.zh: : 名字取好了吗？

lines.en: : I have chosen the name [whatyousaid].
lines.zh: : 我取的名字是 [whatyousaid]。

lines.en: : That sounds kind of familiar.
lines.zh: : 这名字听着有点耳熟。

lines.en: : Hi-yah.
lines.zh: : 嗨呀。

lines.en: : Please stop trying to hit me. You are interrupting my sadness.
lines.zh: : 别再试图打我了。你打断了我的悲伤。

lines.en: : This place will never cure your sadness. It will only make it worse.
lines.zh: : 这地方永远治不好你的悲伤。只会让它更糟。

lines.en: : I know. But sometimes, I deserve to be sad. I’m sure you agree.
lines.zh: : 我知道。但有时候，我活该难过。你肯定同意吧。

lines.en: : Hi-yah.
lines.zh: : 嗨呀。

lines.en: : Wilford, stop.
lines.zh: : Wilford，住手。

lines.en: : The longer this conversation continues, the more desperately I want to tear you to pieces.
lines.zh: : 这对话拖得越久，我就越想把你撕成碎片。

lines.en: : Meanwhile, I just want it to end so I can go back to aimlessly wandering around in hopes of being fixed by some kind of miraculous human-glue.
lines.zh: : 而我呢，只想让这一切赶紧结束，好回去漫无目的地游荡，盼着能被什么神奇的人体胶水给粘好。

lines.en: : This is not aimless. This was a concerted effort to find someone.
lines.zh: : 这可不叫漫无目的。这是为了找到某个人而做出的齐心努力。

lines.en: : You’re right. It was.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。确实是。

lines.en: : Hi-yah.
lines.zh: : 嗨呀。

lines.en: : Wilford.
lines.zh: : Wilford。

lines.en: : Engarde.
lines.zh: : Engarde。

lines.en: : That’s for fencing I think.
lines.zh: : 我记得那是击剑用的吧。

lines.en: : Your mother was a fence.
lines.zh: : 你妈才是一堵栅栏。

lines.en: : No, my mother was a real human female.
lines.zh: : 不，我妈是个真正的人类女性。

lines.en: Wilford’s black hole-less black hole hands grow three steps and connect with my cheek.
lines.zh: Wilford 那没有黑洞的黑洞之手长出三步，正中我的脸颊。

Or maybe he was never here in the first place.

lines.zh: : 嗨！还记得我吗？！

: Are you gonna say {i}anything?{/i} Or are you just going to stand there and act all fucking scared and useless?
lines.zh: : 你倒是说句{i}话{/i}啊？还是说你就打算站在那儿，装出一副吓得要死又一无所用的样子？

lines.en: : Because I was {i}fine{/i} with that when it was temporary. But now that you’re apparently wandering around the fucking city again and have made {i}no{/i} effort to contact me, I’m not sure {i}what{/i} to think.
lines.zh: : 如果只是暂时的，我还{i}受得了{/i}。可现在你显然又开始在这该死的城市里到处乱晃，却{i}根本没{/i}想过联系我，我真不知道该{i}怎么想{/i}了。

lines.en: : In fact, I’m not sure what any of this is about in the first place because there’s nothing I can even {i}think{/i} of that would mess you up as badly as you’ve apparently {i}been{/i} messed up.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我连这一切到底是怎么回事都不清楚，因为我{i}想{/i}不出有什么事能把一个人搞得像你这样惨。

lines.en: : So either talk to me like a fucking {i}man{/i} or tell me to go fuck myself because I am {i}not{/i} Noriko and I am {i}not{/i} going to just deal with this bullshit for the rest of my life.
lines.zh: : 所以，要么像个{i}男人{/i}一样跟我说话，要么就叫我滚去操我自己——因为我{i}不是{/i} Noriko，我{i}不会{/i}就这么一辈子忍这些破事。

lines.en: scene mayashrinemad8
: And wipe that pathetic fucking look off of your face! {i}I’m{/i} the one who should look like that! Not you!
lines.zh: : 还有，把你脸上那副可怜兮兮的蠢样收起来！该摆出那副表情的人是{i}我{/i}！不是你！

lines.en: : What are you doing here?...
lines.zh: : 你来这儿干什么？……

lines.en: : What am {i}I{/i} doing here?! I {i}work{/i} here! And you haven’t set {i}foot{/i} here or {i}anywhere{/i} else I go in months! It’s like you’re {i}trying{/i} to avoid me! I’ve done literally nothing!
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}来这儿干什么？！我在这儿{i}工作{/i}！而这几个月里，你既没踏进这儿{i}一步{/i}，也没去过我去的{i}任何地方{/i}！简直像是在{i}故意{/i}躲我！我可什么都没做过！

lines.en: : And now fucking {i}Ami{/i} thinks something is going on with us as well, so thanks for making that a thing I have to deal with! Appreciate it!
lines.zh: : 现在连 {i}Ami{/i} 都觉得我们俩之间有点什么了，所以谢谢你给我添了这么一件非处理不可的事！真是感激不尽！

lines.en: : You should be in school...
lines.zh: : 你应该在学校里……

lines.en: : I should be in- are there hidden cameras around here or something? Is somebody going to pop out and tell me this is part of some kind of comedy special?
lines.zh: : 我应该在——这附近是不是装了隐藏摄像头什么的？是不是有人要跳出来告诉我，这是什么喜剧特辑的一部分？

lines.en: : Because, if not, that is the stupidest fucking thing you could have said after ghosting me for {i}months,{/i} Sensei! MONTHS!
lines.zh: : 如果不是的话，那这绝对是你人间蒸发了好几个月之后能说出的最蠢的一句话，Sensei！好{i}几个月{/i}！

lines.en: scene mayashrinemad9
: Do you have {i}any{/i} idea what’s been going through my head all this time?! {i}Any?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你知道这段时间我脑子里都在想些什么吗？！{i}一点{/i}都不知道吗？

lines.en: : Because, if you know me well enough- and I’m {i}pretty{/i} fucking sure you do, you’d probably understand just how pissed off I’d have to be to come looking for you, right? Right?!
lines.zh: : 因为如果你足够了解我——而我{i}非常{/i}确定你了解——你就该明白，我得气成什么样才会跑来找你，对吧？对吧？！

lines.en: scene mayashrinemad10
: Are you just {i}bored{/i} of me now or something? Cause you sure picked a hell of a way to break that to me if that’s what’s going on here.
lines.zh: : 你就是对我{i}腻{/i}了还是怎么的？要真是这么回事，你挑的告知方式可真是绝了。

lines.en: : And if it’s not, which I highly doubt it is in the first place, you should probably get to talking. Because it’s not a good look to let a teenage girl fucking scream at you in public while you just stand there.
lines.zh: : 如果不是——虽然我严重怀疑根本不是——你最好赶紧开口。因为让一个十几岁的女孩当街冲你大吼大叫，而你只是站着不动，这画面可不好看。

lines.en: : In fact, it’s not good for us to even be {i}seen{/i} in public. Which is why I’ve done {i}my{/i} job to a fucking {i}T{/i} while {i}you’ve{/i} done jack shit!
lines.zh: : 事实上，我们连{i}被人看见{/i}同框都不该。所以我他妈把{i}该做的{/i}做得{i}滴水不漏{/i}，而{i}你{/i}屁都没干！

lines.en: : How long were you going to make me wait?! {i}Why{/i} were you making me wait?! And why won’t you fucking say anything?!
lines.zh: : 你打算让我等多久？！你{i}为什么{/i}要让我等？！还有你为什么他妈一句话都不说？！

lines.en: : You’re not her...
lines.zh: : 你不是她……

lines.en: : What do you mean I’m not “her?” And which “her” are you talking about in the first place since we agreed not to talk about {i}either{/i} of them?
lines.zh: : 你说我“不是她”是什么意思？再说我们明明说好了不提她们两个中的{i}任何一个{/i}，你到底在说哪个“她”？

lines.en: : You’re not Maya...
lines.zh: : 你不是 Maya……

lines.en: : You’re a meat puppet.
lines.zh: : 你是一具肉身玩偶。

lines.en: scene mayashrinemad11
: Okay, where are the cameras?
lines.zh: : 好了，摄像头在哪儿？

lines.en: scene mayashrinemad12
: There are no cameras.
lines.zh: : 没有摄像头。

lines.en: : Oh, there better be fucking cameras. Because you did {i}not{/i} just call me a “meat puppet” in the middle of an argument about you straight up disappearing on me.
lines.zh: : 哦，最好他妈有摄像头。因为你{i}不{/i}可能真的在一场关于你直接人间蒸发的争吵里管我叫“肉身玩偶”。

lines.en: scene mayashrinemad13
: You want to call me that while we’re fucking? Cool. Fine. Kinda weird, but still fine. Now, though? Are you an idiot? Did Ami scoop some of your brains out mid-coma? What the fuck, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你想在我们做爱的时候这么叫我？行。可以。是有点怪，但也行。可现在？你是白痴吗？Ami 是不是在你昏迷的时候把你脑子挖掉了一块？搞什么鬼啊，Sensei？

lines.en: : As a matter of fact, what did you {i}do{/i} to her in the first place? What happened to her hair? Why is {i}she{/i} suddenly bed-ridden now?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，你到底对她{i}做{/i}了什么？她的头发怎么回事？为什么{i}她{/i}突然就卧床不起了？

lines.en: : Is there some super secret Arakawa family disease that causes all of you to just stop living at the most tragic and dramatic times possible? Because if so, condolences. But also, maybe {i}tell me that?{/i}
lines.zh: : 是不是有什么 Arakawa 家的超级隐秘遗传病，会让你们所有人都在最悲惨、最戏剧性的时刻突然就不活了？如果是的话，节哀。不过，你是不是{i}也该跟我说一声{/i}？

lines.en: : I shouldn’t see you right now...I don’t {i}want{/i} to see you right now...
lines.zh: : 我现在不该见你……我现在不{i}想{/i}见你……

lines.en: scene mayashrinemad14

: Well, then what the fuck is {i}this?!{/i} Because you’re sure as hell not here to {i}pray!{/i} So either you {i}wanted{/i} to see me, or you’re looking for some other shrine maiden to fuck! Which is it?!
lines.zh: : 那{i}这{/i}他妈算什么？！你绝对不是来{i}祈祷{/i}的！所以要么你{i}想{/i}见我，要么你在找别的巫女来操！到底是哪一种？！

lines.en: : Neither...
lines.zh: : 都不是……

lines.en: scene mayashrinemad15
: Uhhhhhhhhhh no. Answer not accepted.
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃，不行。这个回答不接受。

lines.en: : It’s one or the other. Either you want to fuck {i}me,{/i} or you want to fuck someone who isn’t as {i}cute{/i} as me. Which would be dumb. And you’re smarter than that. Which means you are here for me.
lines.zh: : 二选一。要么你想操{i}我{/i}，要么你想操一个没我{i}可爱{/i}的人。后者很蠢。而你没那么蠢。也就是说，你是为我来的。

lines.en: scene mayashrinemad16

lines.en: scene mayashrinemad17

lines.zh: : 然后呢，一切就又都好了！我们就能回到老样子，永远不跟对方正视任何问题，以此高效地维持一段健康的关系！就像我们一直想要的那样！

lines.en: : This isn’t what I want...

lines.en: scene mayashrinemad20
: In half an hour, this better be us or I am going to fucking drag you into an alleyway myself.
lines.zh: : 半小时之内，最好变成我们俩这样，不然我就亲自把你拖进小巷。

lines.en: scene mayashrinemad21
: Can you please just leave me alone?...
lines.zh: : 你能不能别缠着我？……

lines.en: : No! It’s been {i}months!{/i} And we’ve been together for {i}years!{/i} If you’re going to treat me like this, you have to at least explain yourself so I’m not stuck {i}thinking!{/i} I {i}hate{/i} thinking!
lines.zh: : 不行！都好{i}几个月{/i}了！而且我们在一起好{i}几年{/i}了！你要这么对我，至少得给我个解释，别让我一个人在这儿{i}瞎想{/i}！我{i}讨厌{/i}动脑子！

lines.en: : There’s so much shit I’m confused about because {i}you{/i} decided to go into hiding out of nowhere and leave me in the dark!
lines.zh: : 有那么多事让我稀里糊涂的，就因为{i}你{/i}突然人间蒸发，把我蒙在鼓里！

lines.en: : Which, again, would have been totally cool if you gave me a fucking night-light or something instead of locking the door without even saying goodnight!
lines.zh: : 再说一次，你要是给我留个该死的小夜灯什么的，而不是连句晚安都不说就把门锁上，我根本不会这么生气！

lines.en: scene mayashrinemad22
: This is {i}not{/i} how we do things. We don’t fight.
lines.zh: : 我们{i}不是{/i}这么相处的。我们不吵架。

lines.en: : We fuck and we cuddle and we kiss and we part. That’s how it’s always been. And that’s how it {i}should{/i} be because that’s what we {i}want.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我们做爱、拥抱、接吻，然后分开。一直都是这样。也{i}应该{/i}一直这样，因为那就是我们{i}想要{/i}的。

lines.en: : So, yeah. This whole situation has left me pretty fucking agitated because I don’t understand why, all of a sudden, it’s like you’re fucking {i}afraid{/i} of me. What did I do?
lines.zh: : 所以，没错。这整件事把我搞得相当烦躁，因为我不明白为什么你突然就像他妈的{i}怕{/i}我一样。我到底做了什么？

lines.en: Springing forward, summer glow — autumn’s kiss in winter snow.
lines.zh: 春意跃动，夏日流光——秋的吻落在冬雪里。

lines.en: The paths we take, the shoes we wear — those tattered soles in grave despair.
lines.zh: 我们走过的路，我们穿的鞋——那些磨破的鞋底陷入深深的绝望。

lines.en: I once felt death was make-believe. I once felt love, then watched it leave.
lines.zh: 我曾以为死亡只是假扮的游戏。我曾感受过爱，然后看着它离去。

lines.en: Now floorboards creak and call for me — but you won’t speak nor talk to me.
lines.zh: 如今地板吱呀作响，呼唤着我——可你既不开口，也不与我说话。

lines.en: And that’s why I’ll never sleep alone.
lines.zh: 那就是我永远不肯独眠的原因。

lines.en: We’re closer than you know, Boy.
